## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or user interaction
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix or accessibility remediation
- [ ] `test`: New or updated unit/e2e tests
- [ ] `refactor`: Code reorganization with no feature change
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, build scripts, or dependency updates

## Antigravity Verification Checklist

- [ ] Branch originated from latest `main` (`git pull origin main`)
- [ ] Code formatted with Prettier (`npm run format:check`)
- [ ] ESLint passes with zero errors (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Unit tests written and passing (`npm run test:unit`)
- [ ] E2E & WCAG 2.1 AA automated accessibility audit passing (`npm run test:e2e`)
- [ ] Keyboard navigation verified (focus rings visible, modal traps focus)
- [ ] Live regions / ARIA labels provided for dynamic DOM changes
